findings.evidence: `rg -n "@\[expose\].*coinvariantsEquivHom|coinvariantsEquivHom_apply|coinvariantsEquivHom_symm_apply_coe" code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Coinvariants.lean` shows `@[expose] noncomputable def coinvariantsEquivHom` at line 199 and public characterization lemmas at lines 226 and 234.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; if the current `rfl` characterization lemmas force unfolding across the module boundary, restructure the equivalence/lemmas so consumers get explicit forward/inverse characterization theorems without exposing the equivalence body.
findings.issue: `coinvariantsEquivHom` is declared `@[expose]`, so downstream code can unfold and depend on the structure-literal implementation of the universal-property equivalence rather than only its API.

findings.evidence: `rg -n "theorem mem_invariants|theorem mapInvariants_coe_apply|theorem mapInvariants_comp|theorem mem_coinvariants|theorem mapCoinvariants_coe_apply|theorem mapCoinvariants_comp" code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Coinvariants.lean` shows the coinvariant parallels are `@[simp]` at lines 83, 133, and 147, while the invariant versions at lines 264, 289, and 304 have no annotation.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these invariant characteristic lemmas so users of the public `invariants`/`mapInvariants` interface do not have to unfold through the generic `coinvariants` layer manually.
findings.issue: The invariant-specialized normal-form lemmas `mem_invariants`, `mapInvariants_coe_apply`, and `mapInvariants_comp` are not tagged for automation, unlike the parallel coinvariant API.

summary: The invariants surface still leaves its main normal forms out of simp automation, and the universal-property equivalence exposes its implementation body instead of relying on a closed characteristic API.
